title: Havertys Recalls Entertainment Hutches Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The top shelf can fall, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,400.

title: Imagine Nation Books Recalls Wireless Charging Pads Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The wireless phone chargers can overheat while in use, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 64,000.

title: South Shore Furniture Recalls Chest of Drawers Due to Serious Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; One Fatality Reported
summary: The recalled chests are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. Units: About 310,000 (in addition, about 6,900 were sold in Canada).

title: Igloo Recalls Marine Coolers Due to Entrapment and Suffocation Hazards
summary: The cooler's stainless-steel latch can automatically lock when the lid is closed, allowing a person to become locked inside the air tight container, posing entrapment and suffocation hazards. Units: About 60,000.

title: BRP Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fuel Leak and Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicle's fuel delivery system can leak fuel, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 10,000.

title: FIRMAN Power Equipment Recalls Portable Generators Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Costco (Recall Alert)
summary: The generator's carbon canister can leak gas, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 19,000.

title: Greenfield World Trade Recalls Food Dehydrators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The food dehydrator can overheat, posing a fire hazard Units: 2400.

title: DAVIDsTEA Recalls Valentine’s Day Stackable Mugs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The mugs were mislabeled as microwave safe. If microwaved, the metallic print on the mug can spark, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 700.

title: Starbucks Recalls Bodum Recycled Coffee Presses Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The coffee press' plunger knob can break and expose the metal rod, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 230,000 (in addition, about 33,200 units were sold in Canada).

title: DICK'S Sporting Goods Recalls Ethos Pull-Up Assist Due To Laceration Hazard
summary: The plastic clip on the nylon web band that is attached to the resistance band with a carabiner can break, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 10,000.

title: Far East Brokers Recalls Pineapple Corer & Slicers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The metal blade of the slicer can detach, posing a laceration hazard to the consumer. Units: About 2,300.

title: Revelate Designs Recalls Bicycle Seat Bags Due to Crash, Injury Hazards
summary: The straps that fasten the bag to the bike seat can detach and get entangled in the rear wheel of the bike, posing crash and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 1,250.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Textron Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The upper front suspension arms can fail, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 1,700.

title: ION Audio Recalls Portable Speakers Due to Explosion Hazard
summary: Hydrogen gas can leak from the portable speaker battery when charging and the speaker can burst, posing an explosion hazard. Units: About 41,000.

title: Meijer Recalls French Fry Cutters Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The french fry cutter's blade can detach, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 5,800.

title: Beaba Recalls Baby Food Steam Cooker/Blenders Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass bowl can break, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 5,000 (in addition, about 650 were sold in Canada).

title: Hush Recalls Anesthetic Gels, Sprays and Foam Soaps Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The products contain lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children if they put the product on their skin or ingest it. Units: About 275,000.

title: Knape & Vogt Recalls Office Workstations Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The workstation can malfunction, causing the gas cylinders to separate and forcefully discharge, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 76,000.

title: Excel Industries Recalls Zero-Turn Mowers Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: A wire tie underneath the seat could damage the fuel line, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,400.

title: Aegean Apparel Recalls Children's Sleepwear Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The children's sleepwear garments fail to meet the flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 500.

title: Target Recalls USB Charging Cables Due to Shock and Fire Hazards
summary: The metal around the cord can become electrically charged if it contacts the USB wall charger plug prongs while charging, posing shock and fire hazards. Units: About 90,000.

title: Children's Sleep Sacks Recalled by Gildan Activewear Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Sold Exclusively at AmericanApparel.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The children's sleep sacks fail to meet the flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 10,600.
